Operations.Name: IscsiGlobalAluaEnabled
Operations.Description: Returns whether iSCSI ALUA is enabled or not.

Operations.Name: IscsiGlobalIserEnabled
Operations.Description: Returns whether iSER is enabled or not.

Operations.Name: IscsiGlobalSessions
Operations.Description:
Get a list of currently running iSCSI sessions. This includes initiator and target names
and the unique connection IDs.

Arguments.Name: query_filters
Arguments.Description: Query filters to apply to the session listing.

Arguments.Name: query_options
Arguments.Description: Query options for sorting and pagination.

Fields.Name: Alua
Fields.Description: Whether Asymmetric Logical Unit Access (ALUA) is enabled. Enabling is limited to TrueNAS Enterprise-licensed     high availability systems. ALUA only works when configured on both the client and server.

Fields.Name: Basename
Fields.Description: Base name prefix for iSCSI target IQNs.

Fields.Name: Id
Fields.Description: Unique identifier for the global iSCSI configuration.

Fields.Name: Iser
Fields.Description: Whether iSCSI Extensions for RDMA (iSER) are enabled. Enabling is limited to TrueNAS Enterprise-licensed     systems and requires the system and network environment have Remote Direct Memory Access (RDMA)-capable hardware.

Fields.Name: IsnsServers
Fields.Description: Array of iSNS (Internet Storage Name Service) server addresses.

Fields.Name: ListenPort
Fields.Description: TCP port number for iSCSI connections.

Fields.Name: PoolAvailThreshold
Fields.Description: Pool available space threshold percentage or `null` to disable.
